studio_field_source_hint: A copy takes chapters, activities and assessments (as drafts), without learners or grades.
studio_readiness_ready: The course is ready to publish.
studio_readiness_no_live_activity: The course has no published activity.
studio_readiness_assessment_not_ready: The assessment is not published or not ready.
studio_readiness_code_challenge_unconfig: The code challenge is not set up.
studio_readiness_file_submission_unpubli: The file submission is not published.
studio_readiness_file_submission_not_rea: The file submission has no instructions.
studio_readiness_activity_unpublished: The activity is a draft: learners cannot see it.
studio_readiness_certificate_not_configu: The certificate is not set up.
studio_content_empty: The course has no chapters yet
studio_content_empty_hint: A chapter groups the lessons, quizzes and tasks of one topic. Add the first chapter, then fill it with activities.
studio_chapter_empty: This chapter has no activities yet
studio_chapter_delete_consequence: The chapter is deleted with its activities.
studio_activity_delete_consequence: Learners lose its content and their progress in it.
studio_type_hint_video: A YouTube video or your own file
studio_type_hint_document: A PDF read right in the course
studio_type_hint_file_submission: Learners hand in files, you grade them with a rubric
studio_type_hint_exam: A timed quiz with violation tracking
studio_type_hint_code_challenge: A program checked by test cases
studio_access_published: The course is published: every signed-in user finds it in the catalog and can enroll.
studio_access_draft: The course is a draft: only the course team and members of linked groups see it.
studio_access_archived: The course is archived: new enrollments are closed, enrolled learners keep reading it.
studio_groups_hint: Members of a linked group see the course even while it is a draft.
studio_groups_empty: The course is not linked to any group yet
studio_group_unlink_consequence: Its members stop seeing the course while it is a draft.
studio_team_hint: The creator, maintainers and co-authors edit the course. An observer sees the course, even a draft, on its page but changes nothing.
studio_team_remove_consequence: They lose the right to edit the course.
studio_application_reject_consequence: The application is deleted; they can apply again.
studio_details_hint: Learners see the name and description on the course page.
studio_field_open_hint: The course page shows “Become a co-author”.
studio_thumbnail_hint: The image on the course card and course page.
studio_thumbnail_types: JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP or AVIF up to 10 MB.
studio_thumbnail_none: No cover yet: the course card shows this pattern.
studio_certificate_hint: A bilingual Kazakh/Russian certificate is generated automatically after course completion. The learner’s name, issue date and unique number are filled in automatically.
studio_certificate_disable_title: Stop giving a certificate for the course “{name}”?
studio_certificate_disable_consequence: No new certificates are given; certificates already issued stay valid.
studio_archive_hint: An archived course leaves the catalog and is read-only.
studio_archive_consequence: Learners enrolled: {enrolled}, not finished: {inProgress}. Submissions without a grade: {ungraded}, unfinished attempts: {attempts}. The course becomes read-only.
studio_publish_live: Learners see the course in the catalog.
studio_unpublish_consequence: The course leaves the catalog and learners lose access to it.
studio_updates_hint: Learners read them in the “Announcements” tab of the course page.
studio_update_delete_consequence: Learners no longer see it on the course page.
studio_publish_needs_video: Upload the video to publish the lesson.
studio_publish_needs_link: Add the video link to publish the lesson.
studio_publish_needs_document: Upload the document to publish the lesson.
studio_activity_unpublish_consequence: Learners stop seeing the activity; their answers are kept.
studio_media_hint: What learners see in this activity.
studio_youtube_not_link: Paste the full video address, starting with https://.
studio_youtube_not_youtube: This is not a YouTube link: use a youtube.com or youtu.be address.
studio_youtube_no_video: The link has no video in it (a channel, a playlist or a cut-off address). Open the video on YouTube and copy the address from the browser bar.
studio_video_types: MP4, WebM, MKV or MOV up to 2 GB.
studio_activity_settings_hint: Learners see the name in the course content.
studio_custom_no_editor: This legacy activity type has no content editor: learners see it as before, and the studio changes only its name.
studio_learners_hint: Enrolled in the course, newest first.
studio_learners_empty: Nobody has enrolled in the course yet
studio_learner_remove_consequence: The learner’s enrollment and progress go, as if they had left; their submissions stay.
studio_course_delete_hint: Cannot be undone: progress, attempts, grades and issued certificates go with the course. To keep the history, archive the course instead.
studio_course_delete_name: Type the course name to confirm
studio_certificate_optional_hint: Leave blank to omit this from the certificate.
studio_roster_hint: Emails or usernames of people who already have an account: one per line, or separated by commas or semicolons. Up to {max} at a time.
studio_roster_csv_hint: A CSV file from Excel: the email column is used, else the first one. The list goes into the field above.
studio_roster_csv_too_large: The file is larger than 1 MB.
studio_roster_csv_empty: The file has no emails or usernames.
studio_roster_required: Enter at least one email or username.
studio_roster_too_many: At most {max} at a time; the list has {count}.
studio_drag_instructions: To pick up an item, press Space. Move it with the arrow keys and press Space again to drop it in its new place; Escape cancels.
studio_activity_locked_consequence: Learners have submitted work here; deleting would erase it. Hide the activity instead: learners stop seeing it, their submissions and grades are kept.
studio_activity_locked_hidden: Learners have submitted work here, so the activity can’t be deleted. It is already hidden: learners don’t see it, their submissions and grades are kept.
studio_chapter_locked_consequence: Its activities hold learners’ submissions; deleting would erase them. Hide the chapter instead: all its activities are unpublished, the submissions and grades are kept.
studio_chapter_locked_hidden: Its activities hold learners’ submissions, so it can’t be deleted. All its activities are already hidden; the submissions and grades are kept.
studio_inactive_hint: They cannot open the course; bring them back to the team or remove them.
studio_contributor_reactivated: The co-author is back on the team
studio_learnings_hint: The list on the course page. One point per line; an emoji at the start of a line becomes the point's icon.
studio_learnings_too_long: A point is at most {max} characters
studio_field_enrolled_only: Assessments only for learners enrolled in the course
studio_field_enrolled_only_hint: Turn off to let anyone signed in take the quizzes, exams, code tasks and file tasks of a public course.
studio_bulk_consequence: It applies to every selected course that allows it; the rest stay as they are.
studio_roster_preview: List review: what enrolling would do (nobody is enrolled yet)
